meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上本地监控仪表盘,展示智能体组、会话、频道、用户、token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动和实时日志。安装 npm 包和推送模块,每 60 秒发送一次 JSON 快照、每 2 秒推送日志,并在启动时自动加载。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘/看板,或提到本地 dashboard 时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控仪表盘
say.note: 会安装依赖并接入启动流程。

say.text: 按 add-dashboard 技能给 NanoClaw 装监控面板
say.note: 会复制推送模块、改 index.ts、配 .env。

say.text: 添加完 dashboard 后,怎么确认它跑起来了?
say.note: 会给出 curl 检查和浏览器访问方法。

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, real-time logs). Installs the dashboard package and a pusher: JSON snapshot every 60s, log tail every 2s, started from main().
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw (e.g. 'add dashboard' or 'set up a local panel').

say_en.text: Add a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
Run the add-dashboard skill to set up the panel.
say_en.note: Copies pusher, edits index.ts, adds env vars.

say_en.text: How do I verify the dashboard works after adding it?
say_en.note: Shows curl checks and browser URL.
